name: GetJSONNode
label: Get First JSON Node by Key
description: Recursively searches through a JSON structure and returns the first value associated with the specified key.

fields.name: JsonContent
fields.label: JSON Content
fields.description: The JSON content to begin searching. This can be a JSON string or a JToken.

fields.name: KeyToFind
fields.label: Key to Find
fields.description: The name of the JSON key to locate in the structure. Search is recursive and case-sensitive.

fields.name: ResultNode
fields.label: Result Node
fields.description: The first matching JToken found under the specified key. Returns null if no match is found or an error occurs.
